title: Mkpụrụ Obi Onye Ntachi Obi nke Ụlọ Nsọ
intro: N'ime peeji nke Quran, otu onye si n'agbụrụ onye amụma ukwu pụta, nke e nyere dị ka onyinye n'oge agadi. A na-eme emume maka mkpụrụ obi a maka eziokwu na-adịghị agbanwe agbanwe na ọrụ dị ukwuu n'ịmepụta ebe nsọ nke ga-aghọ ihe nnọchianya nke okwukwe. Ka ị na-agụ ihe ndị na-egosi ihe ndị a, gee ntị nke ọma n'olu sitere n'oge gara aga, n'ihi na ọ na-ekwu okwu n'onwe ya.
clues: A kpọrọ m aha n'ime Quran tinyere onye amụma ọzọ dị ka onyinye enyere onye ozi meworo agadi.
Abụ m otu n'ime ụmụ abụọ e nyere onye amụma ahụ mgbe ọ dị afọ iri na ụma.
A na-eto m n'ime Quran maka ime ihe m kwuru.
Ebu m nsọpụrụ nke ịbụ onye amụma ma ezitere m ya dịka onye ozi.
Esonyere m nna m n'ịkwalite ntọala nke Ụlọ Nsọ ahụ.
A na-echeta m dị ka otu n'ime ndị nwere ndidi, ụlọ nsọ anyị wuru ghọkwara ebe a ga-alọghachi ma chekwaa ndị mmadụ.

A gụrụ ya n'etiti ndị ihu abụọ
outcome.answer: A gụrụ ya n'etiti ndị ọrịa

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
